facts.fact: The Ethiopian Telecommunications Agency held the chairmanship of the ARICEA Executive Committee, per ARICEA's own December 2003 presentation (no event date given, so the document's published date is used).

Ethiopia is listed among COMESA's member states, the body under whose auspices ARICEA was launched and which adopted an ICT policy and model ICT bill in March 2003; dated by the document's published date.
